title: Comparações
goal: Aluno sai sabendo formar comparativos com -er (curtos) e more + adjetivo (longos), usar irregulares (better/worse), e comparar pessoas, lugares e produtos naturalmente.
connects_to: M13 (O melhor de tudo) — depois de comparar dois, aprende a destacar O melhor/pior (superlatives).
module_chunks: comparativos curtos: -er + than (taller, smaller, faster, cheaper, older, younger)
regras spelling: big → bigger, hot → hotter, easy → easier, nice → nicer
comparativos longos: more + adjective + than (more expensive, more beautiful, more interesting)
irregulares: good → better, bad → worse, far → farther
the same as / as + adj + as (equality intro)
big / small, fast / slow, cheap / expensive, nice / boring, hot / cold, easy / hard

units.title: Mais alto, mais baixo
units.real_life_context: Você compara pessoas (alturas), coisas (preços) e lugares (tamanhos) usando adjetivos curtos.

grammar.sentence: He is _____ than me.
grammar.explanation: Adjetivos curtos (1 sílaba) usam -er: tall → taller. "More tall" só pra adjetivos longos.

grammar.sentence: This shirt is _____ than that one.
grammar.explanation: "Cheap" (1 sílaba) → "cheaper". Sempre -er pra curtos.

grammar.sentence: I'm _____ than my brother.
grammar.explanation: "Old" → "older". "More old" não existe; "oldest" é superlativo.

grammar.sentence: São Paulo is _____ than Rio.
grammar.explanation: "Big" → "bigger" (dobra o g antes de -er). Regra de spelling: consoante-vogal-consoante dobra.

grammar.sentence: She is _____ than her sister — only fifteen years old.
grammar.explanation: "Young" → "younger" (adiciona -er regularmente).

grammar.sentence: Today is _____ than yesterday — over thirty degrees!
grammar.explanation: "Hot" → "hotter" (dobra o t). Mesma regra de "big → bigger".

grammar.sentence: This test is _____ than the last one — only ten questions!
grammar.explanation: "Easy" → "easier" (y → ier). Adjetivos em -y trocam y por -ier.

grammar.sentence: He is taller as me.
grammar.explanation: Comparativo usa "THAN", não "as". "Taller than" — sempre "than" em comparações com -er.

grammar.sentence: She is more tall than him.
grammar.explanation: "Tall" tem 1 sílaba → -er, não "more". "Taller", não "more tall".

grammar.passage: I'm taller than my brother but he's older than me. Our sister is younger than both of us. She's also faster — she runs every morning.
grammar.question: Quem é mais velho que o narrador?
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "he's / he is older than me" se referindo ao irmão.

listening_speaking.text: This shirt is cheaper than that one.
São Paulo is bigger than Rio.

roleplay.scenario: Charlotte pede pra você comparar duas coisas ou pessoas.
roleplay.opening_line: Compare two things in your life — go!

objectives.hidden_prompt: user compares people with 'X is + adj-er + than + Y' (taller, older, younger, etc.)
user compares with 'X is + adj-er + than + Y' (cheaper, bigger, faster, etc.)
objectives.hint_pt: This phone is cheaper than that one.
objectives.hint_en: This phone is cheaper than that one.
examples_pass: This phone is cheaper than that one.

objectives.hidden_prompt: user makes another comparison with -er + than

roleplay.closing_cue: Charlotte fecha com "Nice comparisons!" quando obj_3 baterem.
roleplay.suggested_flow:
**Suggested flow** (referencial, 6 turnos):

1. **Charlotte**: "Compare two things in your life — go!"
2. **Student**: ~"I'm taller than my sister."
3. **Charlotte**: "Cool. Things?"
4. **Student**: ~"This phone is cheaper than that one."
5. **Charlotte**: "One more!"
6. **Student**: ~"Summer is hotter than winter."
7. **Charlotte**: "Nice comparisons!"

guided_chat.scenario: Charlotte conversa sobre comparações no dia-a-dia.
guided_chat.intro_pt: Charlotte abre chat sobre comparações de dia-a-dia. Pratica -er + than.

objectives.hint_en: São Paulo is bigger than Rio.

objectives.hidden_prompt: user compares possessions with 'X is + adj-er + than Y'

objectives.hint_en: My phone is older than my laptop.
examples_pass: My phone is older than my laptop.

objectives.hidden_prompt: user asks Charlotte 'How about you?' or 'Which is + adj-er for you?'

guided_chat.closing_cue: Charlotte encerra com "Same and different!" quando obj_3 baterem.
guided_chat.suggested_script:
**Script** (referencial, 7 turnos):

1. **Charlotte**: "Quick comparisons — your city vs another."
2. **Student**: "São Paulo is bigger than Rio."
3. **Charlotte**: "By a lot. Things?"

units.title: Mais bonito, mais interessante
units.grammar_focus: Long adjectives (2+ syllables) + more + adj + than
units.real_life_context: Você compara qualidades subjetivas — beleza, interesse, dificuldade.

grammar.sentence: This movie is _____ than that one.
grammar.explanation: "Interesting" (4 sílabas) → "more interesting". Adjetivos longos usam "more", não -er.

grammar.sentence: She is _____ than her sister.
grammar.explanation: "Beautiful" (3 sílabas) → "more beautiful". Sem -er.

grammar.sentence: This restaurant is _____ than that one.
grammar.explanation: "Expensive" (3 sílabas) → "more expensive". Não confundir com "expensiver" (não existe).

grammar.sentence: Algebra is _____ than basic math.
grammar.explanation: "Difficult" (3 sílabas) → "more difficult". Long adj usa "more".

grammar.sentence: Yoga is _____ than running — perfect for stress.
grammar.explanation: "Relaxing" tem 3 sílabas → "more relaxing".

grammar.sentence: This puzzle is _____ than the last one — it's taking hours.
grammar.explanation: "Challenging" 3+ sílabas → "more challenging".

grammar.sentence: She is _____ than him — she always solves the hardest problems.
grammar.explanation: "Intelligent" 4 sílabas → "more intelligent". Sem -er.

grammar.sentence: This book is interestinger than that one.
grammar.answer: This book is more interesting than that one.
grammar.explanation: Adjetivos longos (2+ sílabas) usam "more", não -er. "More interesting", não "interestinger".

grammar.sentence: She is more taller than me.
grammar.explanation: "Tall" 1 sílaba → "taller" (com -er). NÃO usa "more" junto. "Taller", não "more taller".

grammar.passage: This city is more beautiful than my hometown. The food here is more expensive but more delicious. The people are friendlier.
grammar.question: Como a comida é descrita?
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "The food here is more expensive but more delicious".

listening_speaking.text: She is more beautiful than her sister.
Yoga is more relaxing than running.
She is more intelligent than him.

units.title: Melhor, pior, mais, menos
units.real_life_context: Você compara usando os adjetivos irregulares mais comuns.

grammar.sentence: This coffee is _____ than that one.
grammar.explanation: "Good" tem comparativo IRREGULAR: "better" (não "gooder" nem "more good"). Decorar como exceção.

grammar.sentence: Today is _____ than yesterday.
grammar.explanation: "Bad" → "worse" (irregular). Não "badder" (apesar de existir gíria) nem "more bad".

grammar.sentence: She has _____ time than me.
grammar.explanation: "More + uncountable" (more time, more money). "Much" não usado em afirmativas; "many" é pra contáveis.

grammar.sentence: I have _____ books than him.
grammar.explanation: "More + plural countable" (more books). "Many" usado só em pergunta/negativa.

grammar.sentence: My car is _____ than yours — newer and faster.
grammar.explanation: "Good" → "better". Memorize: good/better/best.

grammar.sentence: This movie is _____ than I expected — really boring.
grammar.explanation: "Bad" → "worse". Memorize: bad/worse/worst.

grammar.sentence: He has _____ friends than me.
grammar.explanation: "More" é o comparativo de quantidade — tanto countable quanto uncountable.

grammar.sentence: She is gooder at math.
grammar.explanation: "Gooder" não existe — irregular vira "better". Sempre "better than".

grammar.sentence: This is more bad than yesterday.
grammar.explanation: "Bad" → "worse" (forma irregular). Não "more bad".

grammar.passage: My new phone is better than my old one. The camera is much better but the battery is worse. I have more apps than before.
grammar.question: Como a bateria é comparada com a antiga?
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "the battery is worse".

listening_speaking.text: This coffee is better than that one.
I have more time on weekends.
My phone is better, but slower.
This is worse than I thought.

units.title: Bem mais, um pouco mais
units.real_life_context: Você suaviza ou intensifica comparações — "muito mais", "um pouco mais", "um pouco menos".

grammar.sentence: She is _____ taller than him.
grammar.explanation: "Much + comparative" = MUITO mais. "Much taller" = muito mais alto. "Very" não usa com comparativo.

grammar.sentence: This phone is _____ more expensive.
grammar.explanation: "A little + comparative" = um pouco mais. "A little more expensive" = um pouco mais caro.

grammar.sentence: I'm _____ a bit older than her.
grammar.explanation: "Just a bit older" = só um pouquinho mais velho. Suaviza a diferença.

grammar.sentence: Today is _____ hotter than yesterday.
grammar.explanation: "Much hotter" = bem mais quente. Intensifica.

grammar.sentence: My car is _____ better than my old one.
grammar.explanation: "Much better" = bem melhor. Padrão pra intensificar comparativos.

grammar.sentence: She is _____ more patient than I am.
grammar.explanation: "A little more patient" = um pouco mais paciente. Suaviza.

grammar.sentence: This room is _____ smaller than that one.
grammar.explanation: "A bit smaller" = um pouco menor. Sinônimo de "a little".

grammar.sentence: She is very taller than me.
grammar.answer: She is much taller than me.
grammar.explanation: Com comparativo usa "much", não "very". "Very + adjetivo simples" (very tall); "Much + comparativo" (much taller).

grammar.sentence: I'm a little more better today.
grammar.explanation: "Better" já é comparativo (good → better). NÃO usa "more better". Apenas "a little/much/a bit + better".

grammar.passage: My new apartment is much bigger than the old one. The kitchen is a little smaller, but the bedroom is much more comfortable.
grammar.question: Como é o quarto?
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "the bedroom is much more comfortable".

listening_speaking.text: I'm a bit older than her.

units.title: Comparando tudo
units.real_life_context: Você combina comparativos curtos, longos e irregulares em descrições completas.

grammar.sentence: She is _____ than her sister.
grammar.explanation: Adjetivo curto → -er. "Taller", não "more tall".

grammar.sentence: This restaurant is _____ than the other one.
grammar.explanation: Adjetivo longo → "more". "More expensive".

grammar.sentence: Today is _____ than yesterday.
grammar.explanation: "Good" → "better" (irregular).

grammar.sentence: My car is _____ faster than yours.
grammar.explanation: "Much + comparative". "Very" não vai com comparativo.

grammar.sentence: This phone is _____ (cheap) than that one.
grammar.explanation: "Cheap" (1 sílaba) → "cheaper".

grammar.sentence: She is _____ (intelligent) than I expected.
grammar.explanation: "Intelligent" (4 sílabas) → "more intelligent".

grammar.sentence: Today is _____ (bad) than yesterday.
grammar.explanation: "Bad" → "worse" (irregular).

grammar.sentence: She is more taller than me.
grammar.explanation: Adjetivo curto, sem "more". Apenas "taller".

grammar.sentence: This is gooder than that.
grammar.explanation: Good → better, não "gooder". Irregular.

grammar.passage: I'm taller than my brother but he's much stronger. My sister is more patient than both of us. She's a better listener too.
grammar.question: Quem é o melhor ouvinte?
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "She's / She is a better listener" — se referindo à irmã (melhor ouvinte que o falante e o irmão).

listening_speaking.text: This is more expensive than that.
He is much faster than her.

cross_unit_consolidation: Comparativos curtos: tall → taller, big → bigger, easy → easier
Comparativos longos: interesting → more interesting, beautiful → more beautiful
Irregulares: good → better, bad → worse, far → farther
Sem misturar: "more taller" e "more better" são erros
